overview: True Cross-App Personal Agent — plan multi-dApp Internet Computer workflows on-chain, configure Internet Identity + the official IC MCP server, and run plans from Grok, Claude, or ChatGPT under your II.
features: Log in with Internet Identity and see your principal
Guided Setup for trusting the IC MCP server (mcp.beta.id.ai) with step-by-step Grok, Claude, and ChatGPT connector paths
Grok recommended path via grok.com/connectors custom MCP (no business plan required)
Run now: execute read-only IC queries in the browser (e.g. ICP ledger balance) and show results in chat
Describe cross-dApp goals in chat and get numbered plans with real MCP tool hints
Offline template planner when the operator AI key is not set — still MCP-tool-aware
Copy plans for MCP (clipboard preamble + connector URL) and save as reusable workflows
Store preferred dApps, canister IDs, personal rules, and notes on-chain
Dashboard with MCP status, recent plans, and first-time onboarding
History log of generated plans with re-open support
Cycle-conscious caps on history, workflows, memory size, and model context
